flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob,jobs/ToppanUploadJob,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,models/ToppanStage}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findToppanNoticesForStage), framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl (719-character Toppan file), framework/services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor, framework/controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, framework/workflows/agencies/mha/download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper (particulars update). ocmsadminapi operational/cronproxy/CronProxyService (manual trigger). ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no Toppan letter code
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: SFTP, Code Split (SFTP permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so 'Sesuai' means the code follows the story text. The DR3 letter (final reminder on the driver track) uses the same Toppan machinery as OCMS12.41 and OCMS12.17 (RR3 for owner/hirer); what differs at DR3: amount_payable includes the ADM admin fee, Military/Diplomatic vehicles get no letter (PS-MID/PS-DIP), VIP vehicles get TS-CLV after the letter, and the next stage is CPC. The gaps match OCMS12.41: executeJob() in the scheduler is commented out (letters only through the manual trigger), sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan blocks delivery to the Toppan SFTP in dev/UAT/PROD, the delivery gate is bypassed so the stage and admin fee advance without delivery (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT), and the latest particulars are not always used (OCMS-DF-2026-183 Pending Closure; DataHive FIN/UEN off in PROD). Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-192, -170, -171, -183, -176, -134, -177. Letter text, vendor PDF and Toppan SFTP receipt: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially (60%). The DR3 data file for drivers (including the admin fee) is built correctly, but the daily run is not automatic, delivery to the Toppan SFTP is blocked by config, and the stage and admin fee advance without delivery. Ask URA/team for one DR3 file that reached the Toppan SFTP, lift the sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan block, and re-enable the executeJob call.

steps.step: Due notices at stage DR3 owned by the driver (current offender) are selected for the 3rd letter reminder/notification and the letter job runs
steps.detail: ToppanStage.DR3 (ToppanStage.java:24) is the 3rd letter reminder/notification stage of the driver track (DN1 -> DN2 -> DR3). The findToppanNoticesForStage query takes notices with next_processing_stage = DR3, next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type NULL, an_flag not Y, and joins the owner_driver row with offender_indicator = 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:605-611), so the target is the current offender (the driver after furnish). Foreign vehicle notices without PS-FOR are filtered out (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1950-1959) and notices without a letter_address Y are filtered too (ToppanUploadJob.java:266). For DR3, Military/Diplomatic vehicles are also filtered out and given PS-MID/PS-DIP instead of a letter (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1985-1995). Partial because the job does not run on its own: the Toppan Upload cron is enabled=true in PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62) and processes all stages in order (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-166), but the call toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() in executeDayEndJobs is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so DR3 letters are only generated through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-40, proxied by the staff API in CronProxyService.java:226-228). The real PROD server state: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The letter uses the driver's latest checked particulars (name and address)
steps.detail: The name in the letter comes from onod.name on the offender row (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:595) and the address from the owner_driver_addr row flagged letter_address Y (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2151, 2372). That data is updated by the MHA job for NRIC-holding drivers: the name is written to the offender row (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:854) and the mha_reg address only for rows that are still the offender (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:777-784); the full scope is in OCMS8.3. Partial because (1) a new address only gets letter_address Y when the notice has no address flagged Y yet (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:2321-2322), so an older address can stay in the letter; (2) the DataHive FIN/UEN job is off in PROD (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:52), so FIN-holding drivers are not updated and there is no passport path; (3) ticket OCMS-DF-2026-183 (Pending Closure) reports MHA enquiry files piling up in PROD and OCMS-DF-2026-176 (Ready to UAT) concerns timestamps that also change; OCMS-DF-2026-134 and -177 (Closed) fixed the address overwrite and the offender indicator check. Same fit as the 'latest particulars' step in OCMS12.17.

steps.step: OCMS builds the 3rd letter reminder/notification data file for the vendor (Toppan) to print and post
steps.detail: The file name is URA-DPT-DR3-D1-yyyyMMddHHmmss (ToppanUploadJob.java:280-281) and its content is built by createToppanRequestFileContent: a 719-character header, one 719-character detail line per notice (letter date, notice no, name, address, vehicle no, place, rule), then a trailer with the record count (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:579-595, 602-624, 648-691); the NRIC column is left blank on purpose (lines 663-664). Notices are recorded in ocms_driver_notice for stage DR3 with the driver name and address (ToppanUploadHelper.java:890-897, 1076-1089). The story says 'PDF/data files': OCMS builds a data file; it only builds PDFs for stage ANL (ToppanUploadJob.java:324-343), so the letter PDF is made by the vendor and the letter text: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The file is sent to the vendor over SFTP (via blob and COMCRYPT encryption)
steps.detail: The file is uploaded to blob (ToppanUploadJob.java:314), then OCMS requests a COMCRYPT token for encryption (ToppanUploadJob.java:349-353); the callback encrypts and uploads to the Toppan SFTP. Partial because application-prod.properties:86 sets sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (the comment on lines 84-85 cites OCMS-DF-2026-170) and ComcryptUploadProcessor throws SftpDisabledException for that server (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:203-208). By repo configuration the file does not reach the Toppan SFTP in PROD (nor in dev and UAT: application-dev.properties:77, application-uat.properties:77). The running server state, SFTP permission for the App Service and Toppan receipt: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice is marked as processed: the stage advances from DR3 after the file is sent
steps.detail: After the file is submitted the stage advances through confirmDeliveryAndAdvanceStage and then updateProcessingStage: last_processing_stage is set to DR3, the next stage comes from ocms_stage_map with a fallback to CPC (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1810-1822), amount_payable = composition + ADM admin fee for DR3 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1305-1307, 1833-1835; the ADM value in the DB: cannot verify from repo), an ocms_driver_notice record is created, and VIP vehicles get TS-CLV (ToppanUploadHelper.java:326-335). The stage should only advance when the file is confirmed on the SFTP (ToppanUploadJob.java:430-438). Partial because while sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan the delivery gate is bypassed and the stage still advances (ToppanUploadJob.java:418-430, 444): the notice counts as sent and the admin fee is already added although the file never reached the vendor. That is the behaviour discussed in OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT, not final). OCMS-DF-2026-170/-171 (Closed) about the $15 admin fee wrongly set at non-final stages are fixed (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1318-1325).
